role: Software usability and operational contracts, not biological scoring
fixture_source: Retained E005 short-inclusive GI reference; new deterministic software windows only
fixture_roles: synthetic mean-depth and ambiguity failure contracts
acceptance: Built wheel contains defaults and DAG and works outside checkout in new isolated prefix
Real feature/training/reload/cluster/export paths, matched raw control, exact checkpoint parity
Every contig/DNA once, six strata, zeros, masks, exclusion and noise reasons
Label-free summary independently matches retained E005 counts without science rerun
Serial timing and actual native scheduler evidence, CPU/global-RAM caps without --jobs
Fresh refuses populated directory; partial/full resume do not rerun completed science
Changed input/sample order/config/source/runtime and corrupt/missing/extra outputs rejected
Native invalid-input/insufficient-evidence failures stop dependencies promptly
Intended timeout/fatal failure and orphan termination verified in retained receipts
Parent/child logs, heartbeats, exit codes and cost scope retained

resume_contract.completed: Strict serial prefix of stage receipts, hashes of all output/evidence bytes and parent manifests
resume_contract.failed: Unique retained staging/log directories; retry only failed or never-started stages
resume_contract.unreceipted_published_output: Refuse; preserve evidence and choose fresh output. No automatic repair
resume_contract.snakemake_metadata: After explicit byte verification, ignore incomplete metadata and rerun on mtime only; missing receipts schedule unfinished stages
resume_contract.completion: Bound summaries and all stage receipts; no scientific stages scheduled again
resume_contract.wall_limit: Per invocation, including parent hashing, probes, verification and accounting; a resumed invocation has its own unchanged scientific contract

quality_criterion: None; assigned bp and bin counts are not MAG quality or generalization
